description: Business workflows and the synthetic Testing fixture that lets an ADFAD tester exercise each one. 'seeded' rows are verified by reset-testing-db.js after every reset (query must return at least `min`). 'uat-created' rows have no pre-made fixture: the tester creates them in the UI from the seeded data, and a reset discards them.

workflows.workflow: Faculty directory: different ranks, streams and FTEs
workflows.fixture: seed-base.sql Faculty (31: 5 ranks, 3 streams, FTE 0.5-1.0, 2 inactive)
workflows.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Rank) AS n FROM paws.Faculty WHERE RecordType = N'faculty'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM paws.Faculty WHERE RecordType = N'faculty' AND Active = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM paws.Faculty f WHERE f.RecordType = N'faculty' AND f.Active = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM paws.SessionAssignment sa WHERE sa.FacultyId = f.FacultyId)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM paws.JointAppointment

workflows.workflow: Timetable viewing, filtering, editing and session creation
workflows.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM paws.Session
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT AcademicYear) AS n FROM paws.Session

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT a.FacultyId FROM paws.SessionAssignment a JOIN paws.Session s ON s.SessionId = a.SessionId JOIN paws.SessionAssignment b ON b.FacultyId = a.FacultyId AND b.SessionAssignmentId <> a.SessionAssignmentId JOIN paws.Session t ON t.SessionId = b.SessionId AND t.SessionId <> s.SessionId WHERE s.SessionDate = t.SessionDate AND s.StartTime < t.EndTime AND t.StartTime < s.EndTime GROUP BY a.FacultyId) x
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM paws.Faculty WHERE RecordType IN (N'sessional_pool', N'other_pool')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM paws.TeachingResponsibility WHERE Active = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM paws.RoleAssignment WHERE AcademicYear IN (N'2025-26', N'2027-28')
